entities.summary: Bridgeman Island is one of the South Shetland Islands in Antarctica. It is an almost circular, volcanic island marked by steep sides, measuring 900 by 600 metres with a maximum elevation of 240 m (787 ft) high, lying 45 kilometres (28 mi) east of King George Island.
